name: One-qubit Trotter-Suzuki evolution errors
task_prompt: For the one-qubit Hamiltonian H=0.9*X+0.9*Z, implement exact expm evolution, first-order Lie-Trotter evolution, and symmetric second-order Suzuki evolution to time 1.1 with 8 steps. Print Frobenius errors and state fidelities from |0>, assert all approximations are unitary, and verify the second-order error is smaller than the first-order error for this instance. Return only one complete Python script with no Markdown fences. It must run locally without network access, use fixed seeds whenever randomness is involved, print concise results, and assert every required invariant.
